Avery — thanks for the recap and for being proactive. Responses below, inline: 

- SOC 2: In scope for our core platform (Type II). Most recent report: Oct 2025. Next scheduled assessment: Sep 2026 (we require vendor attestations aligned to our calendar).

- Notification windows: for our legal & risk process we observe the following as standard asks:
  * GDPR: 72 hours to supervisory authority from discovery (we expect a preliminary customer notification within 48 hours if PII is confirmed)
  * HIPAA: for incidents affecting >500 individuals we report to HHS/affected parties within 60 days; smaller incidents follow the standard HITECH guidance — we will want coordination on timelines and messaging
  * Contractual SLAs: we can accept a 24–48 hour preliminary heads-up for suspected incidents so our incident manager can triage internally

- Evidence: please provide the following initial artifacts so our security team can vet operational readiness:
  1) Redacted IR runbook excerpt (play for detection, containment, comms)
  2) SOC 2 one-page summary / scope statement
  3) BCP/DR checklist showing RTO/RPO targets and date of last drill
  4) Contact for emergency escalation (name, role, phone, PGP key if available)

Delivery preference: Google Drive shared folder (oxidata-sec@oxidata.com will have access). If any asset is sensitive, SFTP or encrypted email is fine — call my cell.

I'll also attach our vendor questionnaire (small Q&A) — Ben will own the Q&A on our side.

Cheers,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Security Operations, Oxidata
